title: Top 5 risks & mitigation strategies for K-12 facility & construction managers
summary: Managing K-12 capital bonds requires moving past error-prone spreadsheets. Discover how top school districts use centralized construction project controls, automated policy compliance, and real-time dashboards to stop cost overruns and maintain taxpayer trust.
